phrases.latin: Post prandium Theodōrus cum aviā patinās et vāsa coquīnāria lāvit
phrases.english: After lunch Theo washed the dishes and the pots and pans with Grandma
phrases.source: Libellus III, Apud avum et aviam

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 124, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
